_note: JH16 evaluation panel on the run results page (src/components/Jh16EvaluationPanel.tsx). Interface text: headings, column names, axis titles, the hypothesis-reading labels (reading_<code> for the reading codes supports, contradicts, undecided, not_computable) and the explanatory sentences. Stored data shown as stored: attempt_meaning, the pre-registered hypothesis rule, claim keys, verdict codes (reproduced…) and their rationale, reference set keys and versions, entity ids, flags, missing-reason codes, exploratory analysis ids and reasons, provider parameters and every number. Symbol column names (Ni, Hi %, Nutt…) are identical in both languages. Placeholders in {braces}.
